combinations.name: Lithium
combinations.description: Well-documented seizure trigger — case reports of seizures and blackouts when psychedelics are taken on lithium therapy are consistent enough to take seriously. If you take lithium, this combination is one to sit out.

combinations.name: Cannabis
combinations.description: Intensifies unpredictably. A familiar cannabis dose during the peak or comedown can restart or sharply amplify the trip, and it is the most common ingredient in difficult-experience reports. If combining, start with a fraction of your usual amount.

combinations.name: SSRIs
combinations.description: Chronic SSRI use tends to blunt or shorten the LSD experience — the receptor adaptation works against the agonist. Some people notice little change. Weaker, not dangerous.
